_comment: Procurement item catalogue — the 'Item' layer of the Procurement Knowledge Graph. Each item links to its governing standards (resolved to the edition in force on the tender date by the temporal engine), mandatory regulations (via the regulation registry), the parameters a buyer must decide (slots), clause templates and tests. Clause 'basis' tells the reader where a sentence comes from: standard = required by the cited standard, regulation = required by a QCO/CRS/label order, buyer = a choice the officer made, practice = a recommended default from common Indian public-procurement practice (editable, NOT a statutory limit). Values marked 'practice' must be confirmed by the indenting officer.

items.label: LED lamp (self-ballasted, general lighting)

slots.label: Wattage
slots.question: What wattage should each lamp be?
slots.question_hi: हर बल्ब कितने वाट का होना चाहिए?
slots.why: Wattage fixes light output and energy use; efficacy is tested at rated power.

slots.label: Cap / holder type
slots.question: Which holder: B22 (pin type, common in India) or E27 (screw)?
slots.question_hi: होल्डर कौन सा: B22 (पिन) या E27 (स्क्रू)?
slots.why: A wrong cap makes the lamp unusable in existing fittings.

slots.label: Colour temperature
slots.question: Warm white (2700 K), neutral (4000 K) or cool daylight (6500 K)?
slots.why: Offices and hospitals usually use cool daylight; residences warm white.

slots.label: Minimum luminous efficacy
slots.why: Higher efficacy saves energy but fewer manufacturers qualify — the competition meter shows the trade-off.

spec.heading: Type and Standard
spec.text: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services with {cap_type} cap, for operation on 230 V, 50 Hz single-phase AC supply, conforming to {std:IS 16102 (Part 1)} (safety) and {std:IS 16102 (Part 2)} (performance) including all amendments in force on the last date of bid submission.

spec.heading: Rated Power
spec.text: The rated power of each lamp shall not exceed {rated_power} W.

spec.heading: Luminous Efficacy
spec.text: The luminous efficacy shall not be less than {efficacy} lm/W, measured as per {std:IS 16106}.

spec.heading: Power Factor
spec.text: The power factor shall not be less than {power_factor}, measured as per {std:IS 16106}.

spec.heading: Colour Rendering
spec.text: The colour rendering index (Ra) shall not be less than {cri}, measured as per {std:IS 16106}.

spec.heading: Colour Temperature
spec.text: The rated correlated colour temperature shall be {cct} K; the permitted tolerance shall be as specified in {std:IS 16102 (Part 2)}.

spec.heading: Energy Label
spec.text: Each lamp shall carry a valid BEE star label with a star rating of not less than {star_rating}.

spec.heading: Registration
spec.text: The offered model shall be registered with BIS under the Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) and shall bear the Standard Mark with the registration number (R-number); a copy of the valid registration shall be furnished with the bid.

spec.heading: Marking
spec.text: Each lamp and its carton shall be legibly marked with the manufacturer's name or trade-mark, model, rated power, rated voltage and the R-number.

items.warranty_text: The lamps shall carry a warranty of not less than {warranty_months} months from the date of delivery; lamps failing within the warranty period shall be replaced free of cost.

items.label: LED street light luminaire

slots.label: Wattage
slots.question: What wattage per luminaire? (30–45 W lanes, 60–90 W colony roads, 120–150 W main roads)
slots.question_hi: हर स्ट्रीट लाइट कितने वाट की हो?
slots.why: Wattage depends on road width and pole height.

spec.heading: Type and Standard
spec.text: LED luminaires for road and street lighting conforming to {std:IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 3)} and {std:IS 10322 (Part 1)} including all amendments in force on the last date of bid submission.

spec.heading: Rated Power
spec.text: The rated power shall be {rated_power} W with a tolerance of ± 10%.

spec.heading: System Efficacy
spec.text: The system luminous efficacy shall not be less than {efficacy} lm/W, measured as per {std:IS 16106}.

spec.heading: Power Factor
spec.text: The power factor shall not be less than {power_factor}, measured as per {std:IS 16106}.

spec.heading: Ingress Protection
spec.text: The luminaire shall be {ip} as per {std:IS/IEC 60529}.

spec.heading: Surge Protection
spec.text: Surge protection shall not be less than {surge} kV, tested as per {std:IS 14700 (Part 4/Sec 5)}.

spec.heading: Registration
spec.text: The offered model shall be registered with BIS under the Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS); the registration number (R-number) shall be furnished with the bid.

items.warranty_text: The luminaires shall carry a warranty of not less than {warranty_months} months from the date of commissioning; failed luminaires shall be repaired or replaced.

items.label: PVC insulated wiring cable (up to 1100 V)

slots.label: Conductor size
slots.question: Which conductor size? (1.5 sq mm lighting circuits, 2.5 sq mm power points, 4 sq mm AC/geyser)
slots.question_hi: तार का साइज़ कितना? (लाइट के लिए 1.5 sq mm, पावर प्लग के लिए 2.5 sq mm)
slots.why: Size decides safe current; undersized wire overheats.

slots.label: Insulation type
slots.why: FR-LSH (low smoke) is advisable for hospitals, schools and escape routes.

spec.heading: Type and Standard
spec.text: {cores}-core PVC insulated {insulation} cable with annealed {conductor_material} conductor for working voltages up to and including 1100 V, conforming to {std:IS 694} including all amendments in force on the last date of bid submission.

spec.heading: Conductor
spec.text: The conductor shall conform to {std:IS 8130}; the nominal cross-sectional area of the conductor shall be {conductor_area} sq mm, and the conductor resistance shall comply with {std:IS 8130} when tested as per {std:IS 10810 (Part 5)}.

spec.heading: Fire Performance
spec.text: The oxygen index of the insulation shall not be less than 29%, tested as per {std:IS 10810 (Part 58)}.

spec.heading: Certification
spec.text: The cable shall bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI) under a valid licence (CM/L) as mandated by the Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order, 2003; the licence number shall be furnished with the bid.

spec.heading: Packing and Marking
spec.text: Cable shall be supplied in coils of 90 m (balance quantity as a single cut length), each coil marked with the manufacturer's name, size, length, voltage grade, ISI mark and licence number.

items.warranty_text: The cable shall carry a warranty of not less than {warranty_months} months from the date of delivery against manufacturing defects.

items.label: Electric ceiling fan

slots.label: Sweep
slots.question: Which sweep? (1200 mm is standard for rooms up to ~12 m²; 1400 mm for larger halls)
slots.question_hi: पंखे का साइज़ (स्वीप) कितना? 1200 mm सामान्य कमरे के लिए
slots.why: Sweep must match room size; air delivery limits in IS 374 depend on sweep.

slots.label: Minimum BEE star rating
slots.why: Star rating is mandatory for ceiling fans; a higher minimum saves energy but narrows the market.

spec.heading: Type and Standard
spec.text: Electric ceiling type fans for 230 V, 50 Hz single-phase AC supply conforming to {std:IS 374} including all amendments in force on the last date of bid submission, complete with down-rod, canopy and blades.

spec.heading: Sweep
spec.text: The sweep of the fan shall be {sweep} mm, with tolerance as specified in {std:IS 374}.

spec.heading: Air Delivery
spec.text: The air delivery shall not be less than {air_delivery} m3/min, tested as per {std:IS 374}.

spec.heading: Energy Label
spec.text: Each fan shall carry a valid BEE star label with a star rating of not less than {star_rating}.

spec.heading: Certification
spec.text: The fans shall bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI) under a valid licence (CM/L) as mandated by the Electric Ceiling Type Fans (Quality Control) Order, 2023; the licence number shall be furnished with the bid.

items.warranty_text: The fans shall carry a warranty of not less than {warranty_months} months from the date of installation; defective fans shall be repaired or replaced.

items.label: Miniature circuit breaker (MCB)

slots.label: Rated current
slots.question: Which rating? (6–10 A lighting, 16–20 A power, 32–63 A incomer)
slots.why: The rating must match the cable size of the circuit it protects.

spec.heading: Type and Standard
spec.text: {poles} miniature circuit breakers, {curve}-curve tripping characteristic, conforming to {std:IS/IEC 60898} including all amendments in force on the last date of bid submission.

spec.heading: Rating
spec.text: The rated current shall be {rated_current} A.

spec.heading: Breaking Capacity
spec.text: The rated short-circuit capacity shall not be less than {breaking_capacity} kA, verified as per {std:IS/IEC 60898}.

spec.heading: Certification
spec.text: The MCBs shall bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI) under a valid licence (CM/L) as mandated by the Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices and Accessories (Quality Control) Order, 2003 as amended; the licence number shall be furnished with the bid.

items.warranty_text: The MCBs shall carry a warranty of not less than {warranty_months} months from the date of delivery.

slots.label: Grade
slots.question: Which grade of OPC: 43 (general construction) or 53 (high-strength RCC)?
slots.why: Grade fixes the 28-day strength class under IS 269.

spec.heading: Type and Standard
spec.text: Ordinary Portland Cement {grade} Grade conforming to {std:IS 269} including all amendments in force on the last date of bid submission; all physical and chemical requirements of {std:IS 269} for {grade} Grade shall apply.

spec.heading: Testing
spec.text: Compressive strength shall be tested as per {std:IS 4031 (Part 6)}, setting time as per {std:IS 4031 (Part 5)}, fineness as per {std:IS 4031 (Part 2)} and soundness as per {std:IS 4031 (Part 3)}.

spec.heading: Certification
spec.text: Cement shall bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI) under a valid licence (CM/L) as mandated by the Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003; the licence number shall be furnished with the bid.

spec.heading: Packing
spec.text: Cement shall be supplied in 50 kg bags marked with the ISI mark, licence number, grade and week and year of manufacture; cement older than 90 days from the date of manufacture on the date of delivery shall not be accepted.

slots.label: Grade
slots.question: Which grade? Fe 500D is the usual choice (ductile, suits seismic zones).
slots.question_hi: सरिया का ग्रेड: Fe 500D (सामान्य) या Fe 550D?
slots.why: Grade fixes yield strength and ductility requirements in IS 1786.

slots.label: Diameters
slots.question: Which bar diameters?
slots.why: Sizes come from the structural drawings.

spec.heading: Type and Standard
spec.text: High strength deformed (TMT) steel bars of Grade {grade} conforming to {std:IS 1786} including all amendments in force on the last date of bid submission; all mechanical and chemical requirements of {std:IS 1786} for Grade {grade} shall apply.

spec.heading: Sizes
spec.text: Nominal diameters: {sizes} mm, with tolerances on nominal mass per metre as per {std:IS 1786}.

spec.heading: Testing
spec.text: Tensile properties shall be tested as per {std:IS 1608 (Part 1)}, bend and rebend as per {std:IS 1599} and chemical composition as per {std:IS 228}.

spec.heading: Certification
spec.text: The bars shall bear the BIS Standard Mark (ISI) under a valid licence (CM/L); the licence number shall be furnished with the bid.

items.label: Solar PV module (crystalline silicon)

slots.label: Module rating
slots.question: What module rating (Wp)?
slots.why: Module rating decides the number of modules and structure size.

spec.heading: Type and Standard
spec.text: Crystalline silicon terrestrial PV modules conforming to {std:IS 14286 (Part 1/Sec 1)} and {std:IS/IEC 61730-1} / {std:IS/IEC 61730-2} including all amendments in force on the last date of bid submission.

spec.heading: Rating
spec.text: The rated peak power of each module shall not be less than {module_power} Wp at STC, with only positive power tolerance, tested as per {std:IS 14286 (Part 2)}.

spec.heading: Efficiency
spec.text: The module efficiency shall not be less than {module_efficiency}% at STC.

spec.heading: Registration
spec.text: The offered module model shall be registered with BIS under the Compulsory Registration Scheme; the registration number shall be furnished with the bid.

spec.heading: ALMM
spec.text: The offered module model and manufacturer shall be enlisted in ALMM List-I of MNRE on the last date of bid submission, and the solar cells used shall be from ALMM List-II where applicable to the project.

items.warranty_text: The modules shall carry a product warranty of not less than {warranty_years} years and a linear performance warranty of not less than 25 years from the date of commissioning.
